slides.title: US Embassy: do not travel to Tigray, Amhara or Afar
What the alert says
slides.body: Citizens in those areas should leave if it is safe to do so.

slides.title: Flights
slides.body: Flights remain suspended at Axum and Shire airports.

slides.title: Also
slides.body: The embassy warns of false and misleading social media reports. Verify with several sources.

slides.title: Stay informed. Protect civilians.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: U.S. Embassy Addis Ababa security alert · Nov 4, 2026
